en: Sepia-toned postcard view of a tree-lined road and park area descending along a hillside. A decorative bridge or tunnel entrance is visible on the left side where the road passes through, surrounded by dense foliage. In the distant background above the trees, a church spire rises into the sky. Printed text in the upper left corner reads the name of the city and a specific street or area.
